**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replace the synthetic draft summary with a live capture**

This test splices the old `CODERABBIT_DRAFT_SKIP` block into PR #118's review-in-progress response, while `tests/fixtures/pr-review/coderabbit/README.md` explicitly says that no live draft summary in this format was captured. The resulting invented external-service shape can make `rabbit_summary()` appear compatible even if a real draft summary uses different outer markers or ordering; capture and document an actual response instead.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L16-L20](https://github.com/bronxtc52/skill-superarmanda/blob/692da11ddd76b583dd97e550cca0dc03b138b48f/AGENTS.md#L16-L20)

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Skip dashboard checks when Rich is unavailable**

When Rich is not installed—a supported standalone setup—importing `dash` here raises `ModuleNotFoundError` instead of skipping only the dashboard assertions; running `tests/superarmanda-waves.test.sh` produced five errors from these new tests. The added `Actor.snapshot()` in the e2e suite repeats the unconditional import, and CI installs no Rich dependency before `scripts/run-tests.sh`, so both dashboard-only paths need the same optional-dependency guard used elsewhere in this test file.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
